question: which architecture the committed vocabulary's rule calls for each contig, and on what evidence
nothing_here_is_measured: the rule and every word it attaches are hand-written background knowledge in experiments/virus_vocabulary.json. This script only applies them and records what fired. A contig with no matching evidence is null, never 'not a phage'.
blind_spots: the rule fires on a single matching domain or subject title, so one mislabelled gene calls the whole contig; the evidence that fired is recorded per contig so a reader can see how thin a call is
there is one architecture in the vocabulary, so this cannot distinguish between architectures, only recognise the one it knows or decline
a subject title is a label on a database record. 'ssRNA phage' in a title is a claim made by whoever deposited it

rows.not_called_because: no gene carries a domain or a subject title that any architecture rule in the vocabulary names. This is an absence of evidence and not a call.
